snippet.title: New Game "project" VIRAI: DOOMER’s LIFE ESCAPE" Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the free playtest and add to wishlist on Steam! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3434180/project_VIRAI_DOOMERs_LIFE_ESCAPE/

Support the game's development on Boosty:
https://boosty.to/rikani

Game's Telegram channel: 
https://t.me/doomersvirai

Imagine if Needy Girl Overdose merged with Omori! 
project; VIRAI: DOOMER’s LIFE ESCAPE is a horror-RPG with elements of visual novel and psychological thriller.
Step into the depressive life of a slavic hikikomori girl. Manage her virtual idol to gain fame and change her fate. Can you save her or will you break her completely?
Game made by the co-creator of game “An Alt Girl for Skoof”

🪳 Genre: Horror, psychological thriller, life sim
🖤 Release: 2025

🎥 Video made with love by rik.studio
==============
